mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the bending muscles was worthwhile because it connected the muscle's pull through tendons to elbow movement and explained why relaxation cannot push the arm back.

leastWorthwhile.text: The early fuel-processing sequence felt somewhat repetitive because each step offered only one combination, although the explanations clarified ATP production.

surprise.text: I was interested that opposing muscles can keep pulling without shortening to hold a weight still.
